item.title: Afghanistan accuses Pakistan of carrying out strikes in Kabul targeting hospital treating addicts
item.summary: Afghanistan has accused Pakistan’s military of targeting a hospital treating drug addicts in Kabul in airstrikes that killed and wounded several people

item.title: Artillery attack on a Yemen village kills at least 10 as government blames Houthi rebels
item.summary: An artillery strike has hit a village in northern Yemen and killed at least 10 people, including six children

item.title: 2 dead after 2 boats carrying students capsize off US base construction site in southern Japan
item.summary: Two boats carrying 21 people capsized off Henoko, a controversial relocation site for a U.S. military base on the Japanese island of Okinawa, throwing all into the water and killing two, officials said

item.title: Cuban officials report island-wide blackout as country struggles with energy crisis
item.summary: Ministry reports a "complete disconnection" of the country’s electrical system.

item.title: Myanmar’s parliament meets for first time in 5 years with military controlling most seats
item.summary: Myanmar has opened its first parliamentary session in more than five years following an election that did not include major opposition parties, ensuring that the ruling military is set to retain a firm grasp on power

item.title: 4 teens are suspected of terror offenses in the Rotterdam synagogue explosion, Dutch prosecutors say
item.summary: Dutch prosecutors say four teens are suspected of terror-related offenses after an explosion outside a synagogue in the port city of Rotterdam

item.title: Police in Haiti arrest lawmaker Arnel Belizaire, who faces charges including terror financing
item.summary: Haitian authorities say they have arrested legislator Arnel Belizaire

item.title: Brazil's Bolsonaro out of intensive care unit after condition improves, wife says
item.summary: Jair Bolsonaro moves out of intensive care after doctors see signs his health is improving, according to his wife

item.title: Planned demolition of a building in Nairobi goes wrong, leaves at least 4 dead
item.summary: Officials say a building has collapsed during a planned demolition that went wrong in the Kenyan capital of Nairobi, killing at least four people

item.title: EU border patrol boat capsizes off Greek island with Estonian ambassador aboard
item.summary: A Frontex patrol boat capsized off a tiny Greek island, with the Estonian ambassador to Greece among the five people on board
